hardwarePricing.rule: Upgrade charge = max(0, component price - included allowance) x 1.20, rounded to cents. No credit below allowance. Tuners are priced per six-machine set and pickups per neck + bridge set.
hardwarePricing.provenance: Owner-annotated October 15, 2026 worksheet and subsequent confirmation in chat.

materialPricing.policy: Fixed upgrade prices per selected region: quilted maple $400; flame maple $200; burl top $800 (may require resin filling); body top, back and neck bursts $150 each. Headstock finishes, no burst and burst width add $0. Hardware markup does not apply. Maple fretboard is included.
materialPricing.provenance: Owner instruction: quilted maple, flame maple and burst surcharges; remove White maple; label figured maple back options as veneer. October 16: add burl top at $800 with resin-filling note, restore maple as a fretboard option, rename motif to Cherub Wings.

includedOptionsPolicy: Owner confirmed October 15, 2026: every listed option without an explicit upcharge is included in the build total. Custom requests outside the listed options are reviewed separately.

killswitchResearch.note: Posted labor plus approximately $20 switch gives about $55–$95 installed. $75 is the midpoint used for this new-build option, not a national statistical average.

pickupLayoutPricing.policy: Retain the $200 pickup-package allowance and 20% excess-only markup. HH uses the approved pair snapshot; HSH adds one single coil; HSS/HS allocate half the pair snapshot to the bridge humbucker. SSS/SS use three/two single coils. H always has zero pickup surcharge. Routing and matching selector are included in these new builds. No credit below allowance. Single-coil controls and RWRP middle variant are matched to the chosen layout.
